units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:7">Y. Taan. IV, 68ᶜ</cite>, sq.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 73a">B. Bath. 73ᵃ</cite> Ms. F., v. <cite ref="M02508"><he>מַרְבַּעְתָּא</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: מ׳ (בדיקנא) a parted beard (perh. = מַעְבָּר, pronged like a fork).
מ׳ (דתפלין) the hollow rim of the capsule of the T’fillin of the arm through which the thong is slipped.
